settings.heading: Rooted in Scripture. Made in Texas.
settings.text:
Anointing oil runs through Scripture, from the tabernacle in Exodus to the house at Bethany. We make oils faithful to that tradition, from the botanicals the Bible names.

Each blend is carefully blended, tested, and bottled in Richmond, Texas, on a base of olive-derived squalane. Natural, paraben-free, and vegan, made for prayer and made for skin.

settings.title: Squalane, the delivery vehicle
settings.body: Our base is 100% olive-derived squalane, a lipid similar to the squalene in human skin. It serves as a delivery vehicle, enhancing the bioavailability of every botanical extract in the blend.

settings.title: Polyphenols from olive and pomegranate
settings.body: From the olive come hydroxytyrosol, tyrosol, oleuropein-aglycone derivatives, luteolin, and apigenin. From the pomegranate come ellagitannins and punicalagins. Together they make each oil antioxidant-rich.

settings.title: The Polyphenol Alpha complex
settings.body: Polyphenol Alpha (α) is our proprietary antioxidant-rich complex, derived entirely from natural botanical sources. It blends flavonoids, phenolic acids, stilbenes, and lignans, including ferulic acid, to help neutralize free radicals and support the skin's natural barrier function.

settings.heading: Cosmeceuticals from biblical botanicals.
settings.intro: Every Mount of Olives oil is built on three things: a squalane base, polyphenols drawn from the olive and the pomegranate, and our Polyphenol Alpha complex.

settings.quote: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

settings.question: What is anointing oil?
settings.answer: Anointing oil is oil set apart for prayer, worship, and consecration, a practice that runs through Scripture from Exodus onward. Ours are blended from botanicals the Bible names, on a base of olive-derived squalane.

settings.question: How do I use it?
settings.answer: Apply after showering and towel-drying, or at pulse points such as the wrist. You can also pour a small amount under warm running bath water. For external use only.

settings.question: Is it safe for skin?
settings.answer: Our oils are made for the skin. The base is 100% olive-derived squalane, a lipid similar to the squalene in human skin, and every blend is natural, paraben-free, and vegan. They are for external use only, so please read the ingredient list if you have a known sensitivity.

settings.question: What is in the oils, and are they vegan?
settings.answer: Every ingredient is derived from biblical botanicals: olive oil, olive-derived squalane, the named botanical such as frankincense or spikenard, and our Polyphenol Alpha complex. All of our oils are natural, paraben-free, and vegan.

settings.question: What sizes do you offer, and how does shipping work?
settings.answer: Most blends come in 1 oz (30 mL), 2 oz (60 mL), and 4 oz (118 mL) bottles. Our 100% Squalane Oil comes in 4 oz. US shipping is free on orders of $45 or more.

settings.question: Where are the oils made?
settings.answer: Every oil is carefully blended, tested, and bottled in our studio in Richmond, Texas.
